softwareInnerHero.title: Create Stunning 3D Content with 3ds Max
paragraphs: 3ds Max is a professional 3D computer graphics program for making 3D animations, models, games, and images. Developed by Autodesk, it’s widely used by architects, engineers, and visualization specialists.

With powerful modeling, animation, and rendering tools, 3ds Max enables you to create photorealistic visualizations and compelling virtual reality experiences. Its flexible toolset and extensive plugin ecosystem make it the ideal choice for professionals across industries.
At Aptus Infotech, we provide genuine 3ds Max licenses along with comprehensive training and support to help you bring your creative visions to life.

cardSections.subheading: Discover the capabilities that make 3ds Max the industry standard for 3D content creation

items.title: Advanced Modeling
items.body: Create complex 3D models with precision using polygonal, spline, and NURBS modeling tools. Modify objects with powerful modifiers and procedural modeling techniques.

items.title: Animation & Rigging
items.body: Bring your models to life with comprehensive animation tools. Create character rigs, animate objects, cameras, and lights with keyframe and procedural animation.

items.title: Materials & Texturing
items.body: Apply realistic materials and textures with the Slate Material Editor. Create physically accurate materials using the Autodesk Material Library.

items.title: Rendering
items.body: Produce photorealistic images with the integrated Arnold renderer. Create stunning visualizations with global illumination, caustics, and advanced lighting effects.

items.title: VR & Real-time
items.body: Create immersive VR experiences and real-time visualizations. Export your projects to game engines and VR platforms with seamless workflows.

items.title: Extensibility
items.body: Extend 3ds Max capabilities with thousands of plugins and scripts. Customize the interface and automate workflows with MAXScript and Python.
